our_interpretation: The comparison concerns performance on the 2025 IMO problems in the reported evaluations.

The ordinary reading of 'much stronger' is a substantial score advantage over every named MathArena configuration. It does not establish superiority under equal compute budgets or on mathematics generally.
criteria.support_condition: Both experimental systems have reported, expert-graded IMO 2025 scores substantially above every named model in the referenced MathArena evaluation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Either experimental system lacks the substantial reported score advantage, or reliable checking overturns the results on which that advantage depends.
